# Digital Space Agency

> Independent Flutter and mobile development studio in Hamburg, Germany, run by David Miller (15 years in mobile, 7 shipping Flutter). Also builds AI agents and n8n automations. Available for contract work and open to full-time roles. Works remotely with UK and EU teams on CET.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/): Summary of what David does and selected work
- [Services](https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/services/): Flutter and mobile development, AI agent and n8n automation, technical leadership, FAQ
- [Work](https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/): Apps shipped for FIFA, Porsche, Adidas, Canon, F1 TV, OneFootball, Standard Chartered, IBM for Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1, Accedo, BBC Good Food, plus ReelMatch, Hushdo, FlutterFix, AI agents and n8n automations
- [FIFA](https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/fifa/): Mobile app development for FIFA.
- [Porsche](https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/porsche/): Mobile app development for Porsche.
- [Adidas Training by Runtastic](https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/adidas/): Adidas Training by Runtastic app for the Facebook Portal TV device.
- [Canon Lifecake](https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/canon/): Lifecake, the family photo and video app owned by Canon.
- [F1 TV](https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/f1-tv/): Mobile app for the Formula 1 streaming service.
- [OneFootball](https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/onefootball/): Mobile app for one of the world's largest football media platforms.
- [Shoal for Standard Chartered](https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/standard-chartered/): Shoal, a sustainable savings app with Standard Chartered.
- [IBM for Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1](https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/ibm-mercedes-f1/): Android app for the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team, built through IBM to a tight deadline.
- [Accedo NUVU](https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/accedo/): Nuvu, Ericsson's video-on-demand service for Africa, built through Accedo in Stockholm.
- [BBC Good Food](https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/bbc-good-food/): Recipe app project.
- [ReelMatch](https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/reelmatch/): Swipe trailers with friends, match, and decide what to watch. Flutter, Firebase, TMDB, RevenueCat.
- [Hushdo](https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/hushdo/): Voice notes transcribed and searched entirely on-device with local AI. Zero server uploads.
- [FlutterFix](https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/flutterfix/): Open-source: long-press a bug in your Flutter app and Claude opens a PR with the fix.
- [WBS AI Agents & Automations](https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/work/ai-automations/): n8n workflows and AI agents that run reliably: retries, validation, monitoring.
- [About](https://www.digitalspaceagency.com/about/): Background, availability and how the agency works
